readerCopy.body: The old path may be generous with you precisely because you already know how to walk it. Jupiter trine the South Node can make established knowledge, former connections, proven opportunities, and familiar beliefs work in your favor. Something from the past may pay off with surprisingly little effort. Enjoy the advantage. Just remember that being rewarded for prior experience does not obligate you to build your entire future around the place where you are already fluent.
